A rim sherd of Roman samian ware jar containing graffito on the exterior. While the sherd is undoubtedly of Roman date, the date at which the graffito was added is unclear. Two lines of inscription run across the surface of the object. The first runs diagonally upwards from the left wall and reads [L]EG IIII. The second line begins under the [III] of the first line, and runs horizontally to the right wall. This reads INVI [ ]. The exterior surface is badly scratched with many small grooves, and one large groove runs diagonally across the centre of the face over the first lane, cutting across the [IIII] of the inscription.
